purpose: Validate exact PCM free-coordinate and hard-anchor fixed-offset mapping between native Python CMLE and immer CMLE, while retaining mfrmr JML and unanchored TAM/sirt MML as explicitly different-estimand sensitivity lanes.

r_identity.interpretation: The unreleased dirty mfrmr result applies only to this content hash and must be rerun against a clean released 0.2.3 artifact.

fixture_contract.rating_support: 0..2 retained even when the declared top category is unused
fixture_contract.base_source: Use _pcm_frame from the registered finite-MLE fixture generator without changing response rows.

matched_python_immer_contract.free_coordinates: For each anchored facet, remove the anchored level from W, give every remaining level an identity free coordinate, and do not impose an additional sum-to-zero constraint. Unanchored facets retain sum-to-zero coordinates.
matched_python_immer_contract.fixed_offsets: Pass the anchor contribution through immer_cml(b_const=...). The category kernel uses the same sign convention already validated by the unanchored PCM parity test; fixed offsets must use that convention consistently.
matched_python_immer_contract.steps: Criterion-specific PCM steps retain a separate sum-to-zero transition contrast for C1 and C2 and are never anchored in v1.
matched_python_immer_contract.support: A zero-weight all-2 sentinel declares 0..2 support for every virtual unit without changing sufficient-statistic frequencies.
matched_python_immer_contract.prefit_identity: Before optimization, parameter names, K, conditional NLL and gradient at zero, and conditional-information rank/nullity must independently match Python.
matched_python_immer_contract.optimization: Run immer use_rcpp=FALSE at maxit 200, 2000, and 10000 with reltol 1e-12; maxit 2000 is primary.
matched_python_immer_contract.boundary_rule: Finite coefficients, finite SEs, nominal convergence, or small gradients cannot overwrite Python support-oracle boundary status.

secondary_engine_contract.mfrmr: Run fit_mfrm JML with PCM, step_facet=Criterion, and the exact Rater/Criterion anchors. Retain warnings, errors, readiness, estimate magnitude, and exact anchored-value checks. Never score equality to CMLE.
secondary_engine_contract.TAM: Run tam.mml.mfr MML only for the three unanchored cases. Anchored cases are typed unsupported because an equivalent fixed-coordinate/offset mapping is not registered here. The unused-support case is stopped before fitting if TAM cannot receive the declared support.
secondary_engine_contract.sirt: Run rm.facets MML only for the three unanchored cases in isolated child processes. Anchored cases are typed unsupported; the unused-support case is stopped before fitting.
secondary_engine_contract.no_equivalence: JML and MML results are sensitivity evidence, not PCM-CMLE parity evidence.

success_gates.identity: All Python parents, R package/function identities, adapter identities, and the frozen mfrmr snapshot hash match.
success_gates.fixture_integrity: 12/12 exact case identities and response hashes retained; expected accounting is 6 interior and 6 boundary.
success_gates.python: 12/12 workflow status matches and optimization attempts equal six; all supplied anchors return at exact value with SE zero on ready fits.
success_gates.immer_interior: All six primary interior fits return code zero, finite coefficients/SE/loglik, full information rank, and analytic gradient sup norm <= 1e-6.
success_gates.boundary: All 18 case-by-maxit boundary rows are retained and remain final-readiness false.
success_gates.secondary: mfrmr, TAM, and sirt each produce a complete 12-case fit/unsupported/error ledger; their numerical success is descriptive, not a pass gate.
success_gates.tests: New PCM-anchor contract tests and selected CMLE/anchor/workflow tests pass.

interpretation_limits.anchor_validity: Exact implementation of a fixed anchor does not establish that its value is unbiased or substantively valid.
interpretation_limits.criterion_anchor: Anchoring a Criterion main effect does not anchor its PCM step transitions; those remain sum-to-zero within Criterion.
interpretation_limits.boundary: Finite-MLE existence is conditional on the fixed anchor values and free-coordinate cone.
interpretation_limits.floating_point: All optimizer, gradient, covariance, and rank checks use binary64 tolerances; raw values are retained and display rounding is not a decision input.
interpretation_limits.secondary_estimators: mfrmr JML, TAM MML, and sirt MML cannot validate or invalidate exact conditional PCM equality.
interpretation_limits.mfrmr_snapshot: The dirty temporary snapshot is not a release artifact and may not remain locally available; clean-release rerun is mandatory.
interpretation_limits.generalization: No claim is made for step anchors, group anchors, GPCM slopes, high-dimensional sparse PCM, or public one-click UX.
